_comment: End-of-life data for server software disclosed in HTTP response headers (Server, X-Powered-By, X-AspNet-Version, X-AspNetMvc-Version, MicrosoftSharePointTeamServices, X-OWA-Version, X-Jenkins), in an Outlook Web App, Confluence or Jira page, in a Grafana or Roundcube page, in the Via or kbn-version header, in a default error page, in a nameserver's version.bind answer, or (deep scans) in a mail server's SMTP greeting. Same date-driven schema v2 as library_eol.json; see that file's _comment. One extra field: 'only_flag_below'. Linux distributions keep patching the package versions they ship long after upstream stops, and the audit cannot see from outside whether a given nginx/OpenSSL/Python is a distro package. For those products only release cycles BELOW 'only_flag_below' are judged; that floor is the oldest cycle any distribution still in free support ships, so everything under it is unpatched everywhere. The gate is lifted only when the Server header says the build is for Windows ((Win32), (Win64)), where no distribution is backporting anything. A (Unix) source build of the web server may still link the distribution's patched OpenSSL or Python, so the gate stays on.

php.name: PHP
php._note: Judged on php.net's own lifecycle. Exceptions handled in code: a PHP version string that carries an Ubuntu or Debian package suffix is judged by that distro release, and PHP on Red Hat Enterprise Linux and its rebuilds (Rocky, Alma, Oracle) is judged by Red Hat's Application Stream dates in rhel_appstreams, because both backport security fixes.

rhel_appstreams._note: Retirement date per RHEL major and PHP stream. Full-life streams (7.4 on 8, 8.0 on 9, 8.3 on 10) carry the major's own end of maintenance. Hand-maintained: tools/update_eol_data.py refreshes 'releases' only.

asp.net.name: ASP.NET
asp.net._note: Classic .NET Framework runtime version from X-AspNet-Version. Carried over unchanged from schema v1. Caveat: 2.0.50727 is the CLR version and is also reported by .NET Framework 3.5 SP1, which Microsoft supports until 2029-01-09 as a Windows component.

asp.net-mvc.name: ASP.NET MVC
asp.net-mvc._note: From X-AspNetMvc-Version. Microsoft's ASP.NET support policy lists MVC 5.x as the supported version and gives July 1 2019 as end of support for MVC 4. MVC 1-3 are older than the oldest tracked release and are flagged with it.

apache.name: Apache HTTP Server
apache._note: 2.4 is the only maintained branch and distributions patch within it, so the branch is all that needs judging. No supported distribution ships 2.2 or older.

nginx.name: nginx
nginx._note: Upstream supports only the current stable and mainline branches, but Debian, Ubuntu, RHEL and others ship and patch older branches for years (1.14 on RHEL 8, 1.18 on Ubuntu 22.04, 1.22 on Debian 12). Only branches below 1.14 are flagged: every distribution that shipped them is itself out of free support.

openssl.name: OpenSSL
openssl._note: Appears in Apache 'ServerTokens Full' banners. 1.1.1 and 3.0 are past upstream end of life but still patched by RHEL 8 / Ubuntu 22.04 / Debian 12, so only 1.0.2 and older are flagged. On (Win32)/(Win64) builds no distribution is involved and the upstream dates apply in full.

tomcat.name: Apache Tomcat
tomcat._note: Version comes from the default error page or a Server header that names Tomcat. RHEL 8 and 9 ship and patch Tomcat 9.0 for the life of the release, past upstream's date, so only branches below 9.0 are flagged.

jetty.name: Eclipse Jetty
jetty._note: Jetty 9.4 is past upstream end of life but still packaged and patched by Debian 12, so only 9.3 and older are flagged.

python.name: Python
python._note: Disclosed by Werkzeug, aiohttp, wsgiref and mod_wsgi banners. RHEL 8 patches Python 3.6 until 2029, so only versions below 3.6 (including all of Python 2) are flagged.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby._note: Disclosed by WEBrick banners. Only versions below 2.5 are flagged; newer branches may be distro-maintained.

perl.name: Perl
perl._note: Disclosed by mod_perl in Apache banners. RHEL 8 patches Perl 5.26 until 2029, so only versions below 5.26 are flagged.

sharepoint.name: SharePoint Server
sharepoint._note: From the MicrosoftSharePointTeamServices header. Major 12 = 2007, 14 = 2010, 15 = 2013. Major 16 covers 2016, 2019, Subscription Edition and SharePoint Online; the build number separates them (4xxx-9xxx = 2016, 10xxx-13xxx = 2019). Any other major-16 build is not judged.

exchange.name: Exchange Server
exchange._note: From the X-OWA-Version header, or the build in the Outlook Web App sign-in page's resource paths (/owa/14.3.513.0/themes/... on 2007 and 2010, /owa/auth/15.1.2507/themes/... on 2013 and later). Major 8 = 2007, 14 = 2010, 15.0 = 2013, 15.1 = 2016. 15.2 is shared: Subscription Edition builds start at 15.2.2562, every 2019 build is below it (Microsoft, Exchange Server build numbers and release dates). 'eol' is the end of security support; the paid Extended Security Update period for 2016 and 2019 ended 2026-11-01.

jenkins.name: Jenkins
jenkins._note: From the X-Jenkins header, which Jenkins sends on every response. LTS versions have three parts (2.555.3) and match their LTS line (2.555). Weekly versions have two (2.592): one older than an LTS line that has reached end of life is flagged; newer weekly versions are not judged, since only the latest weekly gets fixes and the audit can't tell how far behind it is. endoflife.date's weekly cycle "2" is skipped (see tools/update_eol_data.py).

confluence.name: Confluence
confluence._note: Confluence Server and Data Center, from <meta name="ajs-version-number"> on every page. Atlassian Cloud pages carry 1000.x build numbers, newer than every tracked release, so they are never flagged. Atlassian ships its own builds, with no distribution packages to backport fixes.

jira.name: Jira
jira._note: Jira Server and Data Center, from <meta name="ajs-version-number">, or on Jira 7 and 8 the application-name meta's data-version or the footer's (v8.20.10#...). The version is Jira's platform version, which Jira Software shares; Jira Service Management runs on the same platform. Atlassian Cloud pages carry 1000.x build numbers and are never flagged.

exim.name: Exim
exim._note: From the SMTP greeting of the domain's mail servers (deep scans), which names the version by default ("ESMTP Exim 4.96"). Upstream supports only the newest release, but Debian 12 (4.96), Debian 13 (4.98), Ubuntu 22.04 (4.95) and Ubuntu 24.04 (4.97) patch the version they ship, so only releases below 4.95 are flagged: every distribution that shipped them is out of free support.

grafana.name: Grafana
grafana._note: From the sign-in page's startup data (window.grafanaBootData, buildInfo.version), present unless the admin set hide_version. Grafana Labs ships its own packages; no distribution maintains old branches. Grafana Cloud runs the current release.

kibana.name: Kibana
kibana._note: From the kbn-version header, which Kibana sends on every response. Elastic ships its own packages; no distribution maintains old branches.

roundcube.name: Roundcube
roundcube._note: From the webmail page's rcmail environment ("rcversion":10604 is 1.6.4). Debian 12 (1.6) and Ubuntu 22.04 (1.5) patch the release they ship, so only releases below 1.5 are flagged.

varnish.name: Varnish Cache
varnish._note: From the Via header Varnish adds by default ("1.1 varnish (Varnish/6.0)") or a Server header naming it. RHEL 8 (6.0), RHEL 9 and Ubuntu 22.04 (6.6) and Debian 12 (7.1) patch the release they ship, so only releases below 6.0 are flagged. CDNs built on Varnish (Fastly) leave the version out. endoflife.date lists only the supported branches, so min_supported marks everything older (4.x, 5.x, all past end of life) as such.

squid.name: Squid
squid._note: From a Server or Via header naming Squid ("squid/4.10"). RHEL 8 (4.x) and later distributions patch the release they ship, so only releases below 4 (all of 3.x and older) are flagged.

bind.name: BIND
bind._note: From the domain's nameservers' answer to version.bind (CHAOS TXT), when it is a real version string. RHEL 8 patches 9.11 until 2029, RHEL 9 9.16, Debian 12 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 9.18, so only versions below 9.11 are flagged.
